name: ZTG Static Site Monitoring Spec

pass_fail_criteria.pass: All probed routes return HTTP 200 within tolerance, canonical/title/h1 checks pass, response time < 3000ms, no unexpected redirects.
pass_fail_criteria.fail: Any expected route returns 404, 5xx, redirect loop, wrong canonical/title, or response time > 3000ms on 2 consecutive probes.

recovery_actions: Propagation wait: re-probe 404/5xx routes after 180s before classifying failure.
404 investigation: confirm file exists in repo/build output; check _headers/.htaccess rewrite rules; inspect redirect chains for broken targets.
404 recovery: restore missing asset from prior build or redeploy last known good commit; verify by re-probe.
5xx investigation: check hosting platform status; inspect build artifact integrity and resource limits.
5xx recovery: redeploy from last known good commit or trigger fresh build; verify platform capacity.
Persistent failure: open incident channel and halt dependent automations if >3 consecutive failures.
